edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _admin() inside the ifAdmin modifier to grant privileged entry.
The constructor forwards msg.sender into _setAdmin, making the deployer the initial admin.
_fallback requires msg.sender != _admin() before delegating, separating admin and user paths.
_fallback reads the admin address via _admin() to enforce the msg.sender != admin guard.
_fallback forwards execution to _delegate with the stored logic address.
_fallback reaches the raw delegatecall that executes untrusted logic code and can re-enter the proxy.
_delegate performs a raw assembly delegatecall to the logic contract, the primary reentrancy entry point.
proposeToAndCall executes a delegatecall with arbitrary calldata, letting external code re-enter proxy functions.
ifAdmin gates the execution of changeAdmin.
ifAdmin gates the execution of upgrade.
ifAdmin gates the execution of cancelUpgrade.
ifAdmin gates the execution of proposeTo.
ifAdmin gates the execution of prolongLock.
ifAdmin gates the execution of proposeToAndCall.
ifAdmin routes non-admin callers into _fallback instead of the privileged body.
The constructor calls _setAdmin to initialize the admin slot.
fallback routes unknown calls into _fallback.
receive routes plain value transfers into _fallback.
changeAdmin reads the current admin through _admin() before transferring rights.
changeAdmin writes the new admin through _setAdmin.
changeAdmin consumes the newAdm parameter and forwards it to _setAdmin.
upgrade enforces block.number >= _nextLogicBlock(), a block-height access gate.
upgrade loads the staged logic address from LOGIC_SLOT.
upgrade writes the new implementation pointer through a raw sstore.
upgrade stores the loaded logic address in a local variable for the event.
cancelUpgrade reads the current logic pointer from LOGIC_SLOT.
cancelUpgrade resets NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT back to the current logic.
proposeTo checks whether an implementation is already set via _logic().
proposeTo refreshes the block slots on first initialization.
proposeTo stages the new implementation through _setNextLogic.
proposeTo consumes the newLogic parameter.
prolongLock performs unchecked assembly addition on PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT, risking overflow.
prolongLock consumes the block_ parameter as the lock extension amount.
prolongLock adds block_ to the stored propose block in assembly with no overflow protection.
proposeToAndCall checks whether an implementation is already set via _logic().
proposeToAndCall refreshes the block slots on first initialization.
proposeToAndCall stages the new implementation through _setNextLogic.
proposeToAndCall consumes the newLogic parameter as storage pointer and delegatecall target.
proposeToAndCall consumes the arbitrary calldata parameter.
proposeToAndCall stores the delegatecall success flag in a local variable used by require.
_setNextLogic enforces block.number >= _proposeBlock(), a block-height access gate.
_setNextLogic validates that nextLogic is a contract via _isContract.
_setNextLogic refreshes the block slots before staging the new implementation.
_setNextLogic writes the staged implementation into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
_setNextLogic consumes the nextLogic parameter.
_setNextLogic writes the staged pointer through a raw sstore.
_updateBlockSlots writes NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
_updateBlockSlots writes PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT from the unchecked expression block.number + 172800.
_updateBlockSlots computes the local proposeBlock value.
_updateBlockSlots computes the local nextLogicBlock value.
_isContract reads the account parameter during the extcodesize check.
_isContract stores the extcodesize result in a local variable.
_setAdmin consumes the newAdm parameter as the new admin address.
_setAdmin writes the ADMIN_SLOT storage location.
_setAdmin performs a raw sstore of the admin slot without any high-level guard.
_logic sloads the LOGIC_SLOT storage location.
_proposeBlock sloads the PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT storage location.
_nextLogicBlock sloads the NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT storage location.
_admin sloads the ADMIN_SLOT storage location.
_delegate consumes the logic_ parameter as the delegatecall destination.
_delegate uses the logic address read from LOGIC_SLOT by its caller.
The delegatecall executes logic code that can re-enter admin functions such as changeAdmin before the caller's state settles.
The delegatecall in proposeToAndCall lets arbitrary external code re-enter changeAdmin and other privileged entry points.
The delegatecall target originates from the LOGIC_SLOT value.
The raw sstore writes the LOGIC_SLOT pointer used by the delegatecall path.
The raw sstore writes the NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT pointer used later for upgrades.
The raw sstore writes the ADMIN_SLOT pointer that governs all admin checks.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter exists only to feed extcodesize inside _isContract.
The newAdm parameter is the sole input written into ADMIN_SLOT by _setAdmin.
The newAdm parameter belongs to the changeAdmin entry point and is forwarded to _setAdmin.
The newLogic parameter is only meaningful inside proposeTo.
The newLogic parameter is consumed directly by the proposeToAndCall delegatecall path.
The calldata parameter is executed only by the delegatecall inside proposeToAndCall.
The block_ parameter is only added into the propose block slot by prolongLock.
The nextLogic parameter is staged into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT only by _setNextLogic.
The logic_ parameter is the delegatecall target used only by _delegate.
The logic local exists only inside upgrade to emit the Upgraded event.
The pb local accumulates the unchecked addition performed by prolongLock.
The proposeBlock local is a temporary used only in _updateBlockSlots.
The nextLogicBlock local is a temporary used only in _updateBlockSlots.
The success local holds the delegatecall result checked by the require in proposeToAndCall.
The size local holds the extcodesize result only within _isContract.
